name: vr-creative-sandbox
description: Physics-real VR creative sandbox (WebXR, Quest 3S target, desktop fallback)

scripts.app: vite build --config vite.view.config.ts --logLevel error && NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1 vite preview --config vite.view.config.ts --port 5173
scripts.breakdown: vite build --config vite.nexus.config.ts --logLevel error && node dist-nexus/breakdown.mjs
scripts.hooks: git config core.hooksPath vr-sandbox/scripts/hooks/git && echo "hooks on: the push gate, the change budget, honesty"
scripts.eval:headset: vite build --config vite.view.config.ts --logLevel error && node tests/evals/headset.cjs
scripts.eval:ask: vite build --config vite.view.config.ts --logLevel error && vitest run --config vitest.eval.config.ts tests/evals/ask.eval.ts --silent=false
